source: official spark-catalyst/spark-sql/spark-sql-api 2.13 4.2.0 sources jars from Maven Central (SHA-1 a6fd043e, ed764828, a4391d9f); read sites from TAG_INVENTORY.json plus manual inspection
statement: The meaning (result bag) of a resolved, optimized logical plan does not depend on the hidden optimizer state listed here. Hidden state may change WHICH rewrites the optimizer or planner performs (control); that cannot affect soundness because every performed logical rewrite is certified on the observed plans. A trace is accepted only if every tag name observed on its plans is listed below, and ANSI mode is on.
trusted: Physical planning and AQE choices (join strategy, broadcast, codegen, empty-relation propagation at runtime) are result-equivalent for a given logical plan.
The static inventory finds read sites by name; reflective, aliased or generic tag reads are not detected.
SQLConf affecting evaluation (ANSI) is unchanged during the logical optimizer run; only its value at the start is observed.

ROOT_REPARTITION.why: read only by PropagateEmptyRelation (optimizer) and AQEPropagateEmptyRelation (runtime re-optimization) to decide whether to keep a root repartition

FAILED_TO_EVALUATE.why: read only by ConstantFolding (optimizer/expressions.scala) to skip re-evaluating an expression that previously failed

processedJoinCondition.why: read only by PushExtraPredicateThroughJoin to avoid re-processing a join condition

dataset_id.why: read by Dataset (API column resolution) and DetectAmbiguousSelfJoin (analysis-time check)

plan_id.why: read only by analyzer column resolution and CheckAnalysis (Spark Connect plan ids)

hidden_output.why: read by Project.metadataOutput and ResolverGuard: name resolution of hidden join keys

by_table_insertion.why: read in expression resolution for table insertion

dataTypeMismatchError.why: read only by the analyzer for error reporting

single_pass_analysis_marker.why: written by the single-pass resolver, never read

user_specified_cast.why: read by default-collation analysis and usePrettyExpression (output column NAMES only)

wholeStageCodegenId.why: read only to print the codegen id in explain output (QueryPlan.scala)

TreeNode._ineffectiveRules.why: protected; read only by transform*WithPruning in TreeNode/AnalysisHelper to skip rule applications

LogicalPlanStats.statsCache.why: statistics for cost-based rules and physical join selection; changes plan shape, not meaning

lazy derived values (canonicalized, reso.why: pure functions of the plan, recomputed or cached

SQLConf (spark.sql.ansi.enabled).why: affects evaluation (overflow, casts); required ON, observed at the start of every executor
